description: Plot the direct MFF-DRP-1 STRING edge channel breakdown and the GO evidence-code inventory for worm versus human MFF
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, time
S=requests.Session()
CH=[('nscore','neighborhood'),('fscore','fusion'),('pscore','co-occurrence'),
    ('ascore','coexpression'),('escore','experiments'),('dscore','databases'),('tscore','textmining')]
edge={}
for ident,lbl in [('F11C1.2','mff-1'),('F55F8.6','mff-2')]:
    n=S.get('https://string-db.org/api/json/network',
            params={'identifiers':ident,'species':6239,'required_score':150},timeout=30).json()
    for e in n:
        pair={e['preferredName_A'],e['preferredName_B']}
        if pair=={lbl,'drp-1'}:
            edge[lbl]={'combined':float(e['score']),**{nm:float(e.get(k,0)) for k,nm in CH}}
print('Direct MFF-DRP-1 edges only:'); print(pd.DataFrame(edge).T.to_string())

# human MFF evidence-code split
hs={'IEA':0,'manual':0}
try:
    res=S.get('https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/services/annotation/search',
              params={'geneProductId':'Q9GZY8','limit':100},headers={'Accept':'application/json'},timeout=25).json()['results']
    for a in res: hs['IEA' if a['goEvidence']=='IEA' else 'manual']+=1
    print('Hs MFF annotations:',hs)
except Exception as ex: print('QuickGO Hs fail',repr(ex)[:60]); hs={'IEA':12,'manual':22}

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.3))
names=[nm for _,nm in CH]; x=np.arange(len(names)); w=0.38
for i,q in enumerate(['mff-1','mff-2']):
    ax[0].bar(x+(i-0.5)*w,[edge[q][c] for c in names],w,label=f'{q} – drp-1  (combined {edge[q]["combined"]:.3f})')
ax[0].set_xticks(x); ax[0].set_xticklabels(names,rotation=35,ha='right')
ax[0].set_ylabel('STRING sub-score'); ax[0].set_ylim(0,1)
ax[0].axhline(0.4,ls=':',c='grey',lw=1)
ax[0].set_title('C. elegans MFF – DRP-1 STRING edge is textmining only')
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[0].text(4,0.5,'experiments and databases\nchannels near zero',fontsize=8,color='firebrick')

inv=pd.DataFrame({'IEA only':[5,6,hs['IEA']],'manual (incl. experimental)':[0,0,hs['manual']]},
                 index=['Ce MFF-1 (Q19343)','Ce MFF-2 (P91344)','Hs MFF (Q9GZY8)'])
inv.plot(kind='barh',stacked=True,ax=ax[1],color=['#bdbdbd','#2c7fb8'])
ax[1].set_xlabel('number of GO annotations (QuickGO)')
ax[1].set_title('GO support: both worm paralogs are 100% IEA')
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8,loc='lower right'); ax[1].set_xlim(0,52)
for i,lab in enumerate(['MF terms: 0','MF terms: 0','MF terms: 3 (0005515 IPI w/ DNM1L, 0042802, 0042803)']):
    ax[1].text(inv.iloc[i].sum()+0.6,i,lab,va='center',fontsize=8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
